features.title: Repository harness baseline
features.userVisibleBehavior: Future agent sessions can restart from AGENTS.md, run one standard init command, and know the current verification contract.
verification: Confirm npm run build and npm run test:agent-benchmark complete in the smoke gate.
evidence: 2026-05-13 bash harness/init.sh passed: git diff --check, npm run build, npm run test:agent-benchmark.
features.notes: Created from the Learn Harness Engineering template structure with project-specific commands and safety rules.

features.title: Agent deterministic benchmark gate
features.userVisibleBehavior: Core Agent behaviors such as feeding records, reminder parsing, expense extraction, skill disclosure, and unsafe mutation boundaries are protected by repeatable tests.
evidence: docs/agent-benchmark-results.md reports PASS, 13 tests, 0 failures, generated 2026-05-13T09:05:58.452Z.
features.notes: New Agent work should add at least one positive and one boundary benchmark case.

features.title: Mobile frontend verification gate
features.userVisibleBehavior: UI changes are checked across phone-sized viewports and common mobile interaction failure modes instead of relying on build success only.
verification: Run npm run verify:frontend for UI or layout changes.
Inspect generated artifacts under .verification/frontend-smoke when failures occur.
evidence: docs/frontend-verification.md defines the viewport matrix and waiver rule.
features.notes: Mark passing only after a current verify:frontend run is recorded for the UI change being shipped.

features.title: Aliyun deployment and live smoke discipline
features.userVisibleBehavior: Cloud releases update code and OTA assets without accidentally overwriting production SQLite data or uploads.
verification: Run SYNC_DATA=0 ECS_HOST=120.55.188.242 npm run deploy:aliyun for code-only deploys.
When behavior changed, run a live probe or documented test account flow.
features.notes: Health alone is not enough for Agent or persistence issues; use DB/journal/probe evidence when the request is about behavior.

features.title: Native Android and iOS parity gate
features.userVisibleBehavior: Native media, reminders, haptics, ASR, OTA, and safe-area behavior are verified on the platform they affect.
verification: Run npm run mobile:sync after native-risk changes.
Run npm run build:android:debug for Android package changes.
Run npm run build:ios:debug for iOS package changes when Xcode signing/build environment is ready.
features.notes: Browser preview cannot prove local notifications, full-screen ringing, microphone permissions, haptics, or WebView-only behavior.
